analysis.grain: attempt; paired grain is task_id, never attempt count
analysis.primary: paired resolved (candidate minus baseline) on frozen sets
analysis.time_note: local duration_seconds includes prep+agent+verify; official 12h covers generation prep but not patch validation; report segments separately

budget_note: 5min is a control variable, not an official hard rule; ~120x5min is ~10h agent ceiling plus prep; do not double blindly

common.compaction_note: notebook 15 vs archived README formal 5 is a doc/default difference; record, do not generalize to formal fixed value
common.seed_note: YAML seed is not forwarded by current LiteLLM whitelist; no determinism claim
common.thinking_note: thinking_budget>=1 numeric values currently map to enable_thinking:true only (4096==1024 in CPU probe); do NOT run 4096-vs-1024 ablation; discernible candidates are thinking on/off and max_output_tokens

data_exposure.dev_future_pool: 73 candidate tasks (76 minus 3 used by P003 explore: fastapi_15280, rich_3905, requests_7315); any new use logged as exposed
data_exposure.heldout: 28 tasks / 26 snapshot groups frozen until final freeze; no intersection with any 002 selection; any early use logged as exposed and no longer independent

promotion_rule: 0C selects capacity base (16384 or 8192) by frozen criteria; phase-1 T0/T1 then both adopt the winner together in a new manifest version; never mix capacities within one pairing

criterion.adopt_8192_if: context anomalies down AND no new truncation AND no repair regression on frozen 6
criterion.else: keep 16384; 6-task result is screening only, full-panel confirmation required before adoption

stage_0c_capacity.evidence_basis: 1437 recorded agent LLM steps max 6114, P95 ~1063, P99 ~2255; 6 success traces (205 steps) max 1494; 0 steps reached 8192; rich_3942-B ContextWindowExceeded at ~88.84s with 16384 reserve
stage_0c_capacity.orders: AB/BA alternation flattened with repeat r1/r2; no selective rerun of flip tasks only
stage_0c_capacity.single_variable: max_output_tokens only; model/prompt/budget/tools/versions/compaction identical; old P003 scores never substitute
stage_0c_capacity.stop_condition: new length truncation / incomplete tool-call JSON / param not taking effect -> inspect raw request first, halt scale-up

tasks.reason: late-edit failure (A0 two edit_file old_string-not-found at ~291/300s)
tool-loop case (B 43 FileReadError, 33 identical params, empty submit)

stage_1_skill.candidate: T1 = T0 + text/AST navigation skill + necessary usage notes (combination strategy; report combination gain; split nav/edit ablation only if mechanism claim needed)
stage_1_skill.frozen_explore: 6 tasks (same role mix as 0C, frozen separately before run); at most 1 candidate advances
stage_1_skill.main_panel: full 24 dev_panel paired T0-vs-T1, report by repo and smoke/other-21 split
stage_1_skill.single_variable: skill only; sampling/budget/tools base identical (on promoted capacity base)

skill.candidate_cap: <=8 candidates, ~4000 chars output initial values for measurement
skill.entry: skills/repo_navigation via run_skill_script in workspace sandbox
skill.forbidden: gold answers, other attempts, host files, test tampering

stage_2_graph: conditional; only after skill base frozen; CPU coverage/retrieval-quality gate first; no forced similarity-retrieval arm if coverage/discrimination insufficient
status: design frozen 2026-09-30; no GPU runs, no submissions under this manifest yet
